name: Associated Students, Inc. (ASI)
description:
The Associated Students, Inc. (ASI) provides support to programs that meet the needs of Sacramento State students and serves as a vehicle for participation in University governance.

Services: Student government, ASI scholarships and grants, internships, student programs, and advocacy.

name: Martin Luther King Jr. Center
description:
The Martin Luther King, Jr. Black Student Resource Center is a central hub for academic success, cultural programming, and community building. It partners with campus and community organizations to support Black students and foster belonging.

Services: Academic advising, the Black Scholars Mentor Program, career and professional development resources, cultural programs, and student community spaces.

name: Student Employment Office
description:
The Student Employment Office, part of the Office of Human Resources, helps students find meaningful work experiences on campus and get the most from their employment.

Services: Student job resources, Federal Work-Study information, job boards, and employment guidance.

name: Peer & Academic Resource Center
description:
PARC promotes scholastic achievement through peer-learning opportunities that support students on the path to degree completion.

Services: Tutoring, Supplemental Instruction, peer advising, academic workshops, and study support.

name: Women's Resource Center
description:
The Women's Resource Center cultivates a safe space where students can be empowered and affirmed while learning about and supporting women-identifying students and allies.

Services: Support services, workshops and events, campus safety resources, and referrals to basic needs and academic support programs.

name: Multi-Cultural Center
description:
The Multi-Cultural Student Resource Center fosters an empowered campus committed to building bridges, promoting social justice, honoring diverse perspectives, and advancing cross-cultural understanding.

Services: Cultural programs, student support services, campus group connections, and community-building events.

name: Disability Access Center
description:
The Disability Access Center works with students, faculty, and staff to provide academic accommodations that ensure disabled students have equal access to education.

Services: Academic accommodations, testing accommodations, assistive technology, the Disability Cultural Center, and a sensory room.

name: College & Department Scholarships
description:
The Scholarships Office supports students with institutional and community scholarship opportunities and helps them navigate the scholarship application process.

Services: Scholarship application support, college and department scholarship information, and financial aid referrals.

name: University Reading and Writing Center
description:
The University Reading and Writing Center provides free, encouraging, and non-judgmental writing support for all Sacramento State students at any stage of the writing process.

Services: One-to-one writing tutoring, drop-in writing help, asynchronous feedback, graduate student support, and ENGL 121 tutoring for credit.

name: UNIQUE
description:
UNIQUE is the University Union's student volunteer programming board, bringing innovative entertainment and educational opportunities to campus.

Services: Concerts, Noon Live performances, lectures, cultural programs, comedy shows, and student event planning experience.

name: Student Technology Center
description:
The Student Technology Center teaches students the technology needed for coursework and collaborates with faculty on technology use in courses.

Services: Presentation assistance, technology workshops, one-on-one software training, large-document printing, and group project support.

name: Student Financial Services Center
description:
The Student Financial Services Center provides cashiering, disbursement, billing, collections, and refund services for students.

Services: Registration, parking, and housing fee payments; refunds; check disbursements; and OneCard services.

name: Center on Race, Immigration & Social Justice
description:
The Center on Race, Immigration & Social Justice addresses social and educational inequities facing the university and larger community through research, programming, and community engagement.

Services: CRISJ programming, the student empowerment scholarship, mentoring, research projects, community engagement, and the Building Justice podcast.

name: Crisis Assistance & Resource Education Support (CARES)
description:
The CARES office supports students in crisis or facing unique challenges to their education by coordinating referrals and follow-up support.

Services: Emergency housing, travel and basic needs grants, CalFresh application assistance, academic case management, and community resource referrals.

name: College of Education's Ed Equity Program
description:
The College of Education's Ed Equity Program prepares educators to create equitable, inclusive educational environments in partnership with local schools and communities.

Services: Educator preparation, equity-focused programming, and community and school partnerships.

name: ASI Food Pantry
description:
The ASI Food Pantry provides food and basic necessities to Sacramento State students experiencing financial hardship or low food security, at no cost.

Services: Free groceries and basic necessities, after-hours locker orders, and CalFresh and basic needs information.

name: Carlsen Center for Innovation & Entrepreneurship
description:
The Carlsen Center for Innovation & Entrepreneurship is a regional hub for accessible entrepreneurial education, community, and support that helps founders explore and launch businesses.

Services: Startup programs, entrepreneurial education, mentorship, community events, and founder resources.
